summary: Aliases such as needs/privileged, needs/root, needs/ssh and needs/httptester declare test requirements.
questions: How do I mark an integration test as needing root?

answer_card.title: Requirement aliases
answer_card.answer_md:
- `needs/privileged`: needs `--docker-privileged` with `--docker`
- `needs/root`: run as root or with `--docker`
- `needs/ssh`: passwordless SSH to localhost/container
- `needs/httptester`: needs the http-test-container
